name: Certificate expiry check (Linux)
description: Shows subject, issuer and days left for a PEM certificate file. Refuses files containing private keys.

params.name: cert_file
params.label: Certificate file
params.description: Absolute path of a PEM or CRT certificate file.

output: Subject, issuer, expiry date and days left. Exit 0; 2 invalid path or private key file; NOT AVAILABLE without openssl.
